name: 39202 · Jackson, MS
findings: ZIP 39202 (Jackson) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 40 organizations.
Economic development organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 39202 (Jackson) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 39202 (Jackson) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 40 organizations here; 26% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
